name: the VAMPnet's slow shell-geometry coordinate
plain: A slow coordinate of a molecule's shell of neighbours that a learned search found. It carries a sliver more than the hand-made order parameter, under the bar set for it.

carrier.state: the first learned coordinate of the VAMPnet dictionary (arm D)

basis.quote: Carrier: SLOW-1's walks (the rigid operator, 250 waters, 50 ps at 20 fs)
basis.note: the coordinate is a learned function of a molecule's neighbourhood

views.reads: the VAMPnet's first coordinate, per molecule

stated.quote: ≥ +0.02 beyond velocity and q on HELD-OUT

budget.quantity: the held-out R² a learned dictionary adds beyond velocity and q; the budget is SLOW-2's stake C2

regime: SLOW-1's walks: the rigid operator, 250 waters, 50 ps at 20 fs; trained on 293 K seeds 0 and 1, read on held-out seed 2

row.quote: | the VAMPnet's slow shell-geometry coordinate | yes, slower than q (`0.50` vs `0.33`) | a sliver, `+0.013` beyond q, under the bar | an uncarried sector |

not_claimed: This increment was read by SLOW-2's own held-out search, not by the removability gate.
The record's `0.498` and `0.331` are what TIERS.md rounds to `0.50` and `0.33`.
